scientific_limitations: Only four methane observation periods are available: May 2019, February 2021, August 2021, and November 2023.
November 2023 has previously influenced model selection and is not an untouched final holdout.
Most model-fold R2 values are negative. Reliable generalization has not been demonstrated.
The month-only model produces the same prediction across spatial nodes within an evaluation period.
The corrected three-way ablation uses a reconstructed Adam/MSE/full-batch training implementation. The original MLP optimizer and loss implementation were not recovered.
Original model-comparison metrics and reconstructed ablation metrics must not be treated as a single controlled ranking because their training protocols are not confirmed to be identical.
The current results do not establish causal relationships between climate variables and methane concentration.
The current dataset is a pilot dataset and does not support claims of a validated long-term India methane forecast.
An untouched future-period holdout and additional independent methane observations are required before operational use.
